newsitem.title: USA: Tesoro buys into East Texas gas hunt.
newsitem.headline: Tesoro buys into East Texas gas hunt.

text.p: Tesoro Petroleum Corp said Thursday it paid Kaiser-Francis Oil Co $3.1 million for a 40 percent interest in an East Texas exploratory venture.

Located in the Cotton Valley Reef Play of East Texas, the deal covers 23 prospects and more than 47,000 gross acres under lease. The areas are centered in Anderson, Cherokee, Henderson, Leon, Nacogdoches, Smith and Van Zandt Counties, Texas, Tesoro said.
Drilling plans will be based on results of seismic data to be gathered this year, said the company.
With this acquisition, Tesoro has an undeveloped leasehold inventory of 43,500 net acres on 38 prospects, a five-fold increase in acreage from 8,000 net acres on 10 prospects at the end of 1995.
